title: Clean hands, shared care
subject: Health literacy
description: A discussion activity for teachers and community workers.
body: Our hands touch many surfaces throughout the day. Washing with soap and water helps remove dirt and germs.
Discuss when your class washes their hands: before eating, after using the toilet, and after playing outside. Ask an adult to help children find a safe washing place.
Make a class poster that shows palms, the backs of hands, between fingers, thumbs, fingertips, and rinsing. This is an educational activity, not individual medical advice.
For clinical or public-health decisions, use current local health guidance and ask a qualified health professional.
question: Which is a useful time to wash your hands?
author: Smriva project
